plantilla-caso.subtitulo: A short one- or two-sentence description of the case study: what problem [concept] solves, for whom, and what the outcome was.

parrafos: Describe the starting point: what need or situation gives rise to the case and why it deserved attention.
Provide the frame: who was involved, what the brief was, and what constraints existed from the outset.
State the core problem precisely: what needed solving and what made it hard.
Add the evidence that backs it up (research, data, signals) to justify the approach.
Explain how you tackled the work, step by step, and what decisions you made along the way.
Use the gallery to show process artifacts (sketches, screens, diagrams).
imagenesAlt: Accessible description of the first process image.
Accessible description of the second process image.

parrafos: Summarize the key decisions and the reasoning behind each: which alternative you chose and what you discarded.

tarjetas.texto: Brief explanation of the decision and its impact.
Brief explanation of the second decision.
Brief explanation of the third decision.

parrafos: Describe the final outcome and its scope: what was delivered and what changed as a result.
secciones.metricaLabel: A noteworthy metric of the result

parrafos: Close with what you learned: what you take away from this case and what you would do the same or differently next time.
